LanguageData.workGiverHighPriorityThresholdLabel: Search work at priority {0} or more important on all floors first
LanguageData.workGiverHighPriorityThresholdTooltip: RimWorld priority 1 is the most important and 4 the least. Work at the chosen priority or more important is searched on every floor before the colonist does lower-priority work on its own floor. The priorities count only while Use work priorities is on in the play settings. 0 turns this pass off.
